Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: multicolor-split-streak, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: offset braid mass. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette moss-ivory. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make the hair construction the primary recognition silhouette. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a bone-free wooden comb only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
